title: My problems with godot
body:
### Tested versions

- Every time I launch play I get a video driver fallback warning that cant be eliminated using flags or settings (ie changing to opengl3), I am on wayland perhaps this is why -- x11 is to be deprecated (imo). The logs do not show anything relevant
- The vertical scrolling speed in the UI is incredibly sensitive compared to my other apps and the setting 'navigation v scroll speed' doesn't do anything to it
- I should be able to see the remote scene (the fact that I cant feels like an architectural decision I strongly disagree with)
- I cant use vim in your built in editor, the godot doesn't support the integration it requires
- vscode doesnt provide lints/errors with any extensions I've found, but i can alt tab to lint with godots editor which is a pain
- The built in editor is horrible and should be an optional plugin that comes uninstalled by default
- You severly f'd up dictionaries by making them lists instead of hashmaps. This is just plain stupid and anyone with a programming background should clearly know why
- Greyboxing works well, I would love a minimalist version of this engine that focuses on just that

These rainbow haired kids are really starting to get to me with their incompetence. Am I the only dev using vim and linux, or am I the only dev using godot? Either way I think I'm too old for this engine...
